name: Teen Volunteer Program at Banner Heart Hospital
what_you_do: Volunteer about 4 hours a week at a heart hospital. Volunteers help in different parts of the hospital.
duration: At least 100 hours within 6 months, or one shift of about 4 hours per week
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Volunteer Application on the page or call (480) 321-4122. The process includes an interview and background research and can take up to 3 weeks.
notes: The Banner volunteer pages are not the same for each hospital. Call first, then apply.
